meta.scope: chromium/src branch main, merged + abandoned CLs; bot-owned CLs excluded from review metrics (counted in weekly_totals.csv)
meta.metric_notes: reviews = non-owner, non-bot accounts that voted Code-Review or wrote a comment; a review with a vote but no counted comment counts as one comment (reported as vote_only_reviews); comments exclude self-declared AI (is_ai flag or autogenerated:* tag; reported separately as ai_comments, a lower bound) and post-merge comments (human comments written after the CL closed; reported separately as post_merge_comments); chars exclude quoted '>' lines
